This is a senior-level distributed systems engineering role on Cloudflare's Cache team, within the Content Delivery group. The work centers on the reverse proxy and caching data plane at Cloudflare's edge — cache storage and indexing, backend routing and load balancing, globally distributed purge, and Tiered Cache routing — along with customer-facing surfaces like Cache Rules, Cache Reserve, and the Workers Cache API. The core stack is Rust (specifically Pingora, Cloudflare's async network services framework) on Linux, with deep HTTP semantics and TCP/TLS/QUIC work, plus production observability through metrics, traces, and profiling.
